issues: Meaning drift: "BUPATI" is rendered as "REGENT"; in this context it should be "REGENT" only if referring to the office, but the heading is the issuing authority and is commonly translated as "REGENT"; however the main issue is the missing separation of the clause "DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA" which should be rendered as a separate line/phrase "BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY" rather than attached to the title, to match the original structure.

Scrambled/incorrect structure: the phrase "DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA" is part of the preamble line and not part of the subject/title; the translation merges it into the title line, altering the document structure.

Meaning drift/omission: in item 3, the original includes the English title in parentheses “(Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women)”, which is missing in the translation.

Meaning drift: in item 10, the translation omits the year in “State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2008 Number 95” (the original implies the year should be included, consistent with the other citations).
Meaning drift in item 4: "penyimpangan" was translated as "deviation"; in context it means "restriction/limitation" of rights, not deviation.
Meaning drift in item 13: "Pelayanan" should be plural/collective "actions/measures" (tindakan) rather than singular "action"; adjust to reflect the original definition without changing substance.
Meaning drift/awkward rendering in item d: "and or" should be "and/or" (serta atau) to accurately reflect the conjunction in the original.
Meaning drift in item l: "layak" is better rendered as "fit/appropriate" rather than "suitable" in this legal-policy context.
Scrambled list structure: item d is merged into item c line and should be a separate list item.
Minor meaning/format issue: "and or" should be "and/or" to reflect "dan/atau" and proper legal phrasing.

Meaning drift: "is caused by" mistranslates "disebabkan oleh" in context; the Indonesian states exploitation is caused by the following acts (i.e., exploitation is constituted by/occurs due to these acts), not that exploitation is caused by something else.
Meaning drift: "forced labor or Services" mistranslates "kerja atau Pelayanan paksa"; should be "forced labor or forced services".
Meaning drift: "sexual abuse" is too broad for "pencabulan"; should be rendered as "indecent acts"/"molestation" to match the legal meaning.
Scrambled list structure: items e, f, and g run together on one line; list markers should be separated and ordered as in the original.

Meaning drift: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" or "Regulation of the Regent" (not "Regent Regulation" is acceptable, but "Regent Regulation" is slightly unnatural; however the main issue is missing the definite article/possessive—should reflect that it is a regulation issued by the Regent).
Scrambled/merged list structure in paragraph (2): item markers and content run together (c. and d. on same line), reducing clarity of separate sub-items.

Meaning drift/awkward rendering in (1): "organisasi Masyarakat pemerhati Masyarakat" translated as "community organizations concerned with the Community"; should reflect organizations/community groups concerned with women/children/violence issues (social concern groups), not "concerned with the Community".

Meaning drift in (4) items d–f: list items are mistranslated/duplicative; original has separate duties "kesehatan" (health), "Rehabilitasi Sosial" (social rehabilitation), and "Pelayanan hukum" (legal services). Current translation renders d as just "health;" and f as "legal Services;" but c already covers legal assistance; needs clearer alignment to original duty labels without implying extra/changed meaning.

Meaning drift: "Regent Regulation" should be "Regent's Regulation" (Peraturan Bupati).
Scrambled/incorrect list punctuation: item b ends with a period instead of a semicolon and item c is run on from b; needs consistent item separation per original structure.

Meaning drift: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" or "Regulation of the Regent" (not "Regent Regulation" without article is acceptable, but needs definite form); however main issue is "ketentraman dan ketertiban" translated as "peace and order" which is less precise than "public tranquility and order" in legal context.
Scrambled list structure: item marker "e." is merged into item d on the same line; should be a separate list item.

Meaning drift: "pemulangan" translated as "repatriation"; should be "return" (sending back/returning home) in this context.
Meaning drift/term accuracy: "Peraturan Bupati" translated as "Regent Regulation"; more accurate is "Regent's Regulation" (a regulation issued by the Regent).
